review_description: Highly recommend Calvin and Celeste from SOUTHSIDE SOLAR AND ELECTRICAL PTY LTD.I researched and compared for months and spoke to many companies. But Calvins design and brands kept staying on top of the pile, especially pricing quality etc.This is a husband and wife team who have excellent communication . Calvin has two apprentices to compliment the installation team. And Celeste is business manager. If you want down to earth honest service ring Calvin . No pushy sales no flashy advertising no misleadingpromises. Just straight forward service. The system is great . The size is perfect for our family and will future proof our energy needs . Specific system is longi 475w panels x 20, SolaX inverter 10000w and 22.1kwh SolaX battery. It is all monitored via the SolaX cloud app on my phone which gives lots of valuable information. I can run 4 x reverse cycle air cons on cold 22degrees high fan and the system easily copes. There is no draw from grid, it is exporting to grid. For a family of four , three fridges , four a/cons , etc this is a perfect system to sheild yourself from grid bills and not fear future rises.RegardsTony
